arguments.description: Per shot, actor and plate family after the pose sheet (D72, D77, D83): generate the key sheet through the imagegen tool from the approved model sheet, the pose sheet's declarations and the shot's cards: row 1 every key of the family at model-sheet scale (cut into key plates), row 2 the same keys as frame thumbnails at the layout camera (the staging proof for C25); overlay, silhouette, spine-fit (C31) and clean-up checks per key; a world's style contract, when the shot visits one, governs row 2 only.
